verses.en: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.pt: Depois olhei, e eis que no firmamento que estava por cima da cabeça dos querubins, apareceu sobre eles uma como pedra de safira, semelhante em forma a um trono.
verses.en_web: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.en_bbe: Then looking, I saw that on the arch which was over the head of the winged ones there was seen over them what seemed like a sapphire stone, having the form of a king's seat.

verses.en: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
verses.pt: E falou ao homem vestido de linho, dizendo: Vai por entre as rodas giradoras, até debaixo do querubim, enche as tuas mãos de brasas acesas dentre os querubins, e espalha-as sobre a cidade. E ele entrou à minha vista.
verses.en_web: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to the man clothed in linen, Go in between the wheels, under the winged ones, and get your two hands full of burning coals from between the winged ones and send them in a shower over the town. And he went in before my eyes.

verses.en: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.pt: E os querubins estavam de pé ao lado direito da casa, quando entrou o homem; e uma nuvem encheu o átrio interior.
verses.en_web: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.en_bbe: Now the winged ones were stationed on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the inner square was full of the cloud.

verses.en: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.
verses.pt: Então se levantou a glória do Senhor de sobre o querubim, e passou para a entrada da casa; e encheu-se a casa duma nuvem, e o átrio se encheu do resplendor da glória do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Yahweh’s glory.
verses.en_bbe: And the glory of the Lord went up from the winged ones and came to rest over the doorstep of the house; and the house was full of the cloud and the open square was full of the shining of the Lord's glory.

verses.en: And the sound of the cherubims’ wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
verses.pt: E o ruído das asas dos querubins se ouvia até o átrio exterior, como a voz do Deus Todo-Poderoso, quando fala.
verses.en_web: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.
verses.en_bbe: And the sound of the wings of the winged ones was clear even in the outer square, like the voice of the Ruler of all.

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
verses.pt: Sucedeu pois que, dando ele ordem ao homem vestido de linho, dizendo: Toma fogo dentre as rodas, dentre os querubins, entrou ele, e pôs-se junto a uma roda.
verses.en_web: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in, and stood beside a wheel.
verses.en_bbe: And when he gave orders to the man clothed in linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the winged ones, then he went in and took his place at the side of a wheel.

verses.en: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
verses.pt: Então estendeu um querubim a sua mão de entre os querubins para o fogo que estava entre os querubins; e tomou dele e o pôs nas mãos do que estava vestido de linho, o qual o tomou, e saiu.
verses.en_web: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
verses.en_bbe: And stretching out his hand to the fire which was between the winged ones, he took some of it and went out.

verses.en: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
verses.pt: E apareceu nos querubins uma semelhança de mão de homem debaixo das suas asas.
verses.en_web: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.
verses.en_bbe: And I saw the form of a man's hands among the winged ones under their wings.

verses.en: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
verses.pt: Então olhei, e eis quatro rodas junto aos querubins, uma roda junto a um querubim, e outra roda junto a outro querubim; e o aspecto das rodas era como o brilho de pedra de crisólita.
verses.en_web: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.
verses.en_bbe: And looking, I saw four wheels by the side of the winged ones, one wheel by the side of a winged one and another wheel by the side of another: and the wheels were like the colour of a beryl stone to the eye.

verses.en: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
verses.pt: E, quanto ao seu aspecto, as quatro tinham a mesma semelhança, como se estivesse uma roda no meio doutra roda.
verses.en_web: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.
verses.en_bbe: In form the four of them were all the same, they seemed like a wheel inside a wheel.

verses.en: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
verses.pt: Andando elas, iam em qualquer das quatro direções sem se virarem quando andavam, mas para o lugar para onde olhava a cabeça, para esse andavam; não se viravam quando andavam.
verses.en_web: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.
verses.en_bbe: When they were moving, they went on their four sides without turning; they went after the head in the direction in which it was looking; they went without turning.

verses.en: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
verses.pt: E todo o seu corpo, as suas costas, as suas mãos, as suas asas, e as rodas que os quatro tinham, estavam cheias de olhos em redor.
verses.en_web: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.
verses.en_bbe: And the edges of the four wheels were full of eyes round about.

verses.en: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
verses.pt: E, quanto às rodas, elas foram chamadas rodas giradoras, ouvindo-o eu.
verses.en_web: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.
verses.en_bbe: As for the wheels, they were named in my hearing, the circling wheels.

verses.en: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.pt: E cada um tinha quatro rostos: o primeiro rosto era rosto de querubim, o segundo era rosto de homem, o terceiro era rosto de leão, e o quarto era rosto de águia.
verses.en_web: Every one them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.
verses.en_bbe: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a winged one, and the second was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

verses.en: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
verses.pt: E os querubins se elevaram ao alto. Eles são os mesmos seres viventes que vi junto ao rio Quebar.
verses.en_web: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
verses.en_bbe: And the winged ones went up on high: this is the living being which I saw by the river Chebar.

verses.en: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.pt: E quando os querubins andavam, andavam as rodas ao lado deles; e quando os querubins levantavam as suas asas, para se elevarem da terra, também as rodas não se separavam do lado deles.
verses.en_web: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.
verses.en_bbe: And when the winged ones went, the wheels went by their side: and when their wings were lifted to take them up from the earth, the wheels were not turned from their side.

verses.en: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.pt: Quando aqueles paravam, paravam estas; e quando aqueles se elevavam, estas se elevavam com eles; pois o espírito do ser vivente estava nelas.
verses.en_web: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.en_bbe: When they were at rest in their place, these were at rest; when they were lifted up, these went up with them: for the spirit of life was in them.

verses.en: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
verses.pt: Então saiu a glória do Senhor de sobre a entrada da casa, e parou sobre os querubins.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.
verses.en_bbe: Then the glory of the Lord went out from the doorstep of the house, and came to rest over the winged ones.

verses.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.pt: E os querubins alçaram as suas asas, e se elevaram da terra à minha vista, quando saíram, acompanhados pelas rodas ao lado deles; e pararam à entrada da porta oriental da casa do Senhor, e a glória do Deus de Israel estava em cima sobre eles.
verses.en_web: The cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.en_bbe: And the winged ones, lifting up their wings, went up from the earth before my eyes, with the wheels by their side: and they came to rest at the east doorway of the Lord's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them on high.

verses.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
verses.pt: São estes os seres viventes que vi debaixo do Deus de Israel, junto ao rio Quebar; e percebi que eram querubins.
verses.en_web: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.en_bbe: This is the living being which I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and it was clear to me that they were the winged ones.

verses.en: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.pt: Cada um tinha quatro rostos e cada um quatro asas; e debaixo das suas asas havia a semelhança de mãos de homem.
verses.en_web: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.en_bbe: Every one had four faces and every one had four wings; and hands like a man's hands were under their wings.

verses.en: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
verses.pt: E a semelhança dos seus rostos era a dos rostos que eu tinha visto junto ao rio Quebar; tinham a mesma aparência, eram eles mesmos; cada um andava em linha reta para a frente.
verses.en_web: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
verses.en_bbe: As for the form of their faces, they were the faces whose form I saw by the river Chebar; when they went, every one of them went straight forward.
